sampling.rule: For each source choose minimum VAL familyID, bothdt, intervals0/2/5; no outcome/error-driven choice.
sampling.side_h_rule: hp=min(.01,.5*(ctrlupper-u)); hm=min(.01,.5*(u-ctrllower)); compute each independently. Actualdu is F64 endpoint subtraction. Side abs(actualdu)<1e-6 unavailable, retain reason; never clip and never shrink feasible opposite side to match.
sampling.symmetry: Primary is separate one-sided finite-action response. Do not silently call unequal hp/hm a centered derivative. No three-point interpolation is prescribed.

restore_and_replay.source: Raw source_integration_F64 before the original interval action, full300 mjSTATE_INTEGRATION/signature16383, actual native time bits retained.
restore_and_replay.preserve: Restore ALL integration state, current nonzero qvel, previouscontrol/warmstart/history, globaltick/time; do not recreate from state58, zero current velocity, or add a forward that changes context.
restore_and_replay.safety_reference: Every branch uses original episode initial qpos/COM/quaternion from selected_operands; current probe state is not a new initial condition.
restore_and_replay.baseline_gate: First run all12 original-u baselines and reproduce original source/after-action/target receipts, POST qpos/qvel and complete H labels. Any failure blocks new action response qualification; preserve failure/no automatic retry.
restore_and_replay.baseline_numeric: Raw state/receipt/qpos/qvel/ctrl use exact F64 bytes. Native contact summaries/59 derived arithmetic use1e-10 absolute+relative solely as saved arithmetic agreement, never a dynamics accuracy gate.
restore_and_replay.partial: Keep all attempted branch prefixes, full raw receipts/contacts/actualtimes/termination. A partialH has NaN H target59/state58/delta52; observed prefix stays separately. No model-vs-short-prefix endpoint comparison.
restore_and_replay.eligible_comparison: Baseline replay passes AND perturbed branch has complete64/128 H, finite state/contacts and no warning. Preserve other branches with masks/reasons, no success-only reporting.

observations.delta52: q20 rad/qd20 rad_s/pCOM_world3 m/Log(Rtarget Rsource.T)_world3 rad/vCOM_world3 m_s/omega_world3 rad_s
observations.coverage: Strict per-PRE-tick pad positive-normal sum>0.1N; coverage is a fraction, not contact force or cachedself15.
observations.time: POST H endpoints; each force label aggregates full64/128 solver-PRE ticks; lastPRE=H-native_dt.
observations.extra: Save predicted and native full body-to-world R9 and COM3/velocity/omega. Do not collapse orientation to one yaw, project native matrices or substitute inertial axes.

comparisons.primary: For every available side: native_s=(Ynative_side-Ynative_base)/du_F64; model_s_same_step=(Ymodel_side-Ymodel_base)/du_F64. Same state and actualF64 action endpoints; native F64, model input/output FP32 then castF64 for subtraction.
comparisons.model_AD: Parameters/frozen buffers fixed; action-only AD at original state/action FP32. g_j=dYmodel59/du_j in physical output units; includes normalization chain, sigmoid coverage and physical logforce output.
comparisons.own_model_AD_check: ModelFD=(Ymodel_side-Ymodel_base)/du_FP32actual; compare g_j to this finite step, not a claimed exact derivative of physics. du_FP32 is cast endpoint subtraction in F64. If0, undefined/null+mask, retain values.
comparisons.quantization: Save full endpoint/baseFP32 command bytes, signeddu_F64/signeddu_FP32, ratio anddifference. Any rounding/collapse is reported; no hidden physical-vs-model precision equivalence.
comparisons.statistics: All12states/8directions/2sides retained. Perblock/perfeature signed bias, MAE, componentRMSE, vectorRMS; native/model secant norms and norm error. Cosine only if both norms>0, otherwise null/mask. No mixed-unit59 Euclidean score as sole conclusion.
comparisons.TRAIN_normalization: Additional perfeature errors divided by population std of59 from original684 eligible TRAIN rows only; frozen in operands. std==0 gives null/mask for normalized value; all raw-unit values remain. Never refit using VAL/native newbranch/TEST.
comparisons.contact_changes: Save baseline/side per-PRE tick contact geom/active signatures and loaded/unloaded switches. Crossing manifolds yields finite-action secants; learned AD is not true contact derivative/Jacobian.
comparisons.aggregate_cohorts: ALL/sourcebranch/dt/sourceinterval/direction/side; this is exploratory VAL local analysis with repeated sources, not independent trials/CI or unseen real-ego generalization.

engineering_only: unauthorized ctrl clamp or out-of-range command
changed model/material/gains/solver or original safety baseline
failure_gates.native_partial_or_warning: Preserved outcome with comparison maskFalse, no fabricated H target; no resampling substitute.
failure_gates.derivative_or_accuracy: No pass threshold, sign filter, noise floor, weight tuning, checkpoint selection, retraining, policy improvement, holding success or true-Jacobian qualification is defined.

fixed_scope.context: Two mapped poses from oneego frame under assumed simulator parameters; validation used during training, so this is not a new blind confirmation. No J/K truth or independent real contact-force measurement.
